category_title: Preschoolers at risk for developmental delays with mild to moderate language disorders
scenario_title: Developing a play plan during the advanced play organizer
minimal_context: The student and a peer are in the classroom with kitchen toys, tasked with developing a play plan for the session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to make a play plan for the kitchen toys. What do you want to do with them?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands away from the peer and looks at the floor, appearing lonely and anxious instead of initiating a conversation.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Talk to your friend and decide what to play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains completely silent, making no comments to the peer about the toys.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Come on, you need to make a plan together. Tell each other what to do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows increased anxiety during the awkward silence and begins to have a temper tantrum, throwing a plastic plate and refusing to follow directions.)
